kind: Prospective C4 stage one protocol and setup evidence; no sustained measurements
origin: Scaleway EM-B220E-NVMe, Ubuntu 24.04, two independently mapped Samsung NVMe drives
before_timed_reads: Commit these exact protocol bytes and the source archive, publish the commit, verify its Git receipt, then run in tmux. Protocol chronology is independently reviewable; a receipt alone is not proof of publication.
before_each_arm: Require the same boot, device identity and source hashes
Wait until all SSD sensors are at most 45 C
Save SMART health, available thermal counters and physical I/O counters
Start original F1 power, suspend and foreign-read collection
analysis: Record the first 600 seconds but exclude them from sustained-rate estimates. Use complete 60-second windows thereafter. 0.9 * window P10 is a provisional planner heuristic, not a guaranteed lower bound.
